text:
faye: Received ticket from Altis Labs — Feb invoice shows two PDFs for same period; one PDF missing embedding line items. Ticket #BILL-10234.
billing-bot: reconcile-daily completed 2025-06-10T07:00:00Z. Alert: duplicate_invoice_group detected for customer_id=AL-77 period=2025-02.
omar: invoice ids?
faye: INV-2025-33021 and INV-2025-33021-1. Totals differ by $0.19; first-created lacks embedding_line_items. Customer attached both PDFs.
sylvie: quick log snippet suggests a transient DB timeout during line_items flush and retry created a second invoice before the first finished attaching items. Logs: ```
2025-02-28T23:59:59Z WARN invoice_writer: flush_line_items timeout (pgconn reset)
2025-02-28T23:59:59Z INFO invoice_writer: retrying create (idempotency_key=null)
2025-02-28T23:59:59Z INFO invoice_writer: created invoice INV-2025-33021-1 (no line_items)
```
omar: ok — duplicate + missing lines. Customer wants corrected invoice asap. Finance ops, approve manual remediation?
ops-approve: Approve emergency remediation: void duplicate invoice and issue credit. Cap refund <= $8k. Authorize manual action; document in ticket.
faye: Running remediation script now: `./tools/finance/void_and_credit --invoice INV-2025-33021-1 --reason "duplicate retry"`
faye: Done. Credit CR-8421 issued for $3,210.44 and INV-2025-33021-1 voided. Notified CS and customer. Ticket updated #BILL-10234.
eng-oncall: Root cause appears to be missing fallback idempotency when request_id is null and non-atomic invoice+line_items writes. I'll open a hotfix PR to: (1) derive fallback idempotency = sha256(customer_id + period + usage_checksum), (2) wrap invoice+line_items in DB transaction, (3) add integration test simulating line_items timeout. Targeting hotfix today. PR will also centralize money math to integer cents.
omar: please also add a temporary alert: surface invoices for same customer+period created within 3 minutes. Add runbook step to search before manual void.
faye: noted — added runbook checklist and scheduled a reconciliation pass after the hotfix. Closing loop for ticket; postmortem requested (BILL-10234-PM). :white_check_mark:
